1	(* psi_descent.v — Milestone 4: Descent-set effect of psi                   *)

3	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
4	Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm.
5	
6	Set Implicit Arguments.
7	Unset Strict Implicit.
8	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
9	
10	(* ===== Milestone 4: Descent-set effect of psi ============================== *)
11	(* Reference: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md (informal proof note).             *)
12	(* Stanley EC1 (2nd ed.) section 1.6.3, Fact #2: how psi_i changes the        *)
13	(* descent set of w.                                                           *)
14	
15	(* ----- M4.0 Descent predicate for seq nat --------------------------------- *)
16	
17	Definition is_descent_seq (w : seq nat) (k : nat) : bool :=
18	  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.
19	
20	Example is_descent_seq_ex :
21	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
22	  [seq k <- iota 0 7 | is_descent_seq w k] = [:: 0; 3; 5].
23	Proof. by []. Qed.
24	
25	(* ----- M4.1 Tree classifier: has_left_child -------------------------------- *)
26	(* Vertex i has a left child iff i > 0 at its recursive level, i.e.,          *)
27	(* mm_pos of the containing subarray is strictly to the right of the          *)
28	(* subarray's left boundary. Mirrors window_size_fuel's recursion.            *)
29	
30	Fixpoint has_left_child_fuel (fuel : nat) (i : nat) (s : seq nat) : bool :=
31	  match fuel with
32	  | 0 => false
33	  | fuel'.+1 =>
34	      match s with
35	      | [::] => false
36	      | _ :: _ =>
37	          let j := mm_pos s in
38	          if i < j then has_left_child_fuel fuel' i (take j s)
39	          else if i == j then (0 < j)
40	          else has_left_child_fuel fuel' (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s)
41	      end
42	  end.
43	
44	Definition has_left_child (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
45	  has_left_child_fuel (size w) i w.
46	
47	(* Vertex 2 (value 4) in [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6]: subarray [4;7;5], mm_pos=0,
48	   left subtree empty => no left child. *)
49	Example has_left_child_false :
50	  has_left_child 2 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = false.
51	Proof. by []. Qed.
52	
53	(* Vertex 5 (value 9): subarray [4;7;5;9;2;6], mm_pos=3 (relative),
54	   left subtree [4;7;5] nonempty => has left child. *)
55	Example has_left_child_true :
56	  has_left_child 5 [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] = true.
57	Proof. by []. Qed.
58	
59	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_0 : forall fuel s,
60	  has_left_child_fuel fuel 0 s = false.
61	Proof.
62	elim=> [//|fuel IH] [//|a s0].
63	by simpl; case: ifP => Hlt; [apply: IH | case: ifP].
64	Qed.
65	
66	Lemma has_left_child_0 s : has_left_child 0 s = false.
67	Proof. exact: has_left_child_fuel_0. Qed.
68	
69	Lemma has_left_child_fuel_monotone fuel1 fuel2 i s :
70	  size s <= fuel1 -> fuel1 <= fuel2 ->
71	  has_left_child_fuel fuel2 i s = has_left_child_fuel fuel1 i s.
72	Proof.
73	Admitted.
74	
75	Lemma has_left_child_cons i a s0 :
76	  let s := a :: s0 in
77	  let j := mm_pos s in
78	  has_left_child i s =
79	    if i < j then has_left_child i (take j s)
80	    else if i == j then (0 < j)
81	    else has_left_child (i - j - 1) (drop j.+1 s).
82	Proof.
83	Admitted.
84	
85	
86	(* Non-triviality: L = [4;7;5], head=4=min, p=1, q=2.
87	   nth 0 L 1 = 7, nth 0 L 2 = 5: 7 > 5 = true.
88	   rank_shift_seq [4;7;5] = [7;5;4]: nth 0 _ 1 = 5, nth 0 _ 2 = 4: 5 > 4 = true. *)
89	Example rank_shift_interior_order_ex :
90	  let L := [:: 4; 7; 5] in
91	  (nth 0 L 1 > nth 0 L 2) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 2).
92	Proof. by []. Qed.
93	
94	(* ----- M4.4 Window head is extremum --------------------------------------- *)
95	(* Proved as Lemma window_head_extremum in the T6 section above.             *)
96	(* The Axiom window_head_is_extremum has been retired.                       *)
97	
98	(* ----- M4.5 Boundary lemmas ----------------------------------------------- *)
99	(* The element just after the window is an ancestor's extremum, hence either  *)
100	(* less than min(window) or greater than max(window). Since rank_shift only  *)
101	(* permutes the window values, the descent bit at the right boundary is      *)
102	(* unchanged.                                                                *)
103	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 2 (Case 4).          *)
104	
105	Lemma post_window_extremum i w :
106	  uniq w -> i + window_size i w < size w ->
107	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) < nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
108	  (nth 0 w (i + window_size i w) > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
109	                                        (window_size i w).-1).
110	Proof.
111	Admitted.
112	
113	(* Non-triviality: w = [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6], i=2. Window = [4;7;5] at [2,5).
114	   Post-window element at position 5: w[5] = 9. max(window) = 7.
115	   9 > 7 = true: post-window element is > max(window). *)
116	Example post_window_extremum_ex :
117	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
118	  nth 0 w (2 + window_size 2 w) > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at 2 w)) (window_size 2 w).-1.
119	Proof. by []. Qed.
120	
121	(* ----- M4.6 Pre-window lemmas (Case LR) ----------------------------------- *)
122	(* When vertex i has both children and head = min, the max of the subarray   *)
123	(* is in the right subtree, so max(window) = max(subarray) > w[i-1].        *)
124	(* Symmetrically when head = max, min(window) = min(subarray) < w[i-1].     *)
125	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 4.                   *)
126	
127	Lemma pre_window_lt_max_when_min_head :
128	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
129	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
130	  1 < window_size i w ->
131	  head 0 (window_at i w) == nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
132	  nth 0 w i.-1 <
133	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) (window_size i w).-1.
134	Proof.
135	Admitted.
136	
137	Lemma pre_window_gt_min_when_max_head :
138	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
139	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
140	  1 < window_size i w ->
141	  head 0 (window_at i w) ==
142	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) (window_size i w).-1 ->
143	  nth 0 w i.-1 > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0.
144	Proof.
145	Admitted.
146	
147	(* Non-triviality: w = [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6], i=5. Window = [9;2;6].
148	   Head = 9 = max. min(window) = 2. w[4] = 5 > 2. *)
149	Example pre_window_gt_min_ex :
150	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
151	  nth 0 w 4 > nth 0 (sort leq (window_at 5 w)) 0.
152	Proof. by []. Qed.
153	
154	(* ----- M4.7 Exactly-one-descent in Case LR -------------------------------- *)
155	(* When vertex i has both children, w[i] is an extremum of S_i (the full     *)
156	(* subtree), so w[i-1] and w[i+1] are on opposite sides of w[i]. Exactly    *)
157	(* one of {i-1, i} is a descent.                                            *)
158	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md section 4.1.                 *)
159	
160	Lemma exactly_one_descent_LR :
161	  forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat),
162	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> has_left_child i w ->
163	  1 < window_size i w ->
164	  is_descent_seq w i.-1 (+) is_descent_seq w i.
165	Proof.
166	Admitted.
167	
168	(* Non-triviality: w = [3;1;4;7;5;9;2;6], i=5.
169	   is_descent_seq w 4 = (5 > 9) = false.
170	   is_descent_seq w 5 = (9 > 2) = true.
171	   false (+) true = true. *)
172	Example exactly_one_descent_LR_ex :
173	  let w := [:: 3; 1; 4; 7; 5; 9; 2; 6] in
174	  is_descent_seq w 4 (+) is_descent_seq w 5.
175	Proof. by []. Qed.
176	
177	(* ----- M4.8 Helpers for descent-effect proofs ----------------------------- *)
178	
179	Lemma pred_sub_add i j :
180	  j < i -> 0 < i - j - 1 ->
181	  (i - j - 1).-1 + j.+1 = i.-1.
182	Proof.
183	Admitted.
184	
185	Lemma pre_window_extremum_R i w :
186	  uniq w -> 0 < i -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
187	  1 < window_size i w ->
188	  (nth 0 w i.-1 <
189	     nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0) \/
190	  (nth 0 w i.-1 >
191	     nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
192	           (window_size i w).-1).
193	Proof.
194	Admitted.
195	
196	(* ===== M4.8 Helpers for main descent-effect theorems ====================== *)
197	
198	Lemma window_at_uniq i w :
199	  uniq w -> uniq (window_at i w).
200	Proof.
201	move=> Hu.
202	apply: (subseq_uniq (take_subseq _ _)).
203	by apply: (subseq_uniq (drop_subseq _ _)).
204	Qed.
205	
206	Lemma size_window_at i w :
207	  i < size w -> size (window_at i w) = window_size i w.
208	Proof.
209	move=> Hiw.
210	rewrite /window_at size_take size_drop.
211	case: ltnP => // Hge.
212	by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hge window_size_bound.
213	Qed.
214	
215	(* nth in window_at = nth in w, offset by i. *)
216	Lemma nth_window_at i w j :
217	  i < size w -> j < window_size i w ->
218	  nth 0 (window_at i w) j = nth 0 w (i + j).
219	Proof.
220	move=> Hiw Hj.
221	by rewrite /window_at (nth_take _ Hj) nth_drop
222	   addnC.
223	Qed.
224	
225	(* Element of L is between min(sort L) and max(sort L). *)
226	Lemma elem_in_range (L : seq nat) (j : nat) :
227	  j < size L ->
228	  nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 <= nth 0 L j /\
229	  nth 0 L j <= nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1.
230	Proof.
231	Admitted.
232	
233	(* When head of window is min, not a descent at i. *)
234	Lemma head_min_not_descent i w :
235	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w ->
236	  head 0 (window_at i w) =
237	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w)) 0 ->
238	  ~~ is_descent_seq w i.
239	Proof.
240	Admitted.
241	
242	(* When head of window is max, descent at i. *)
243	Lemma head_max_is_descent i w :
244	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w ->
245	  head 0 (window_at i w) =
246	    nth 0 (sort leq (window_at i w))
247	          (window_size i w).-1 ->
248	  is_descent_seq w i.
249	Proof.
250	Admitted.
251	
252	(* Element of rank_shift_seq L is between min and max of sorted L. *)
253	Lemma elem_rs_in_range (L : seq nat) (j : nat) :
254	  j < size L ->
255	  nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 <=
256	    nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) j /\
257	  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) j <=
258	    nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1.
259	Proof.
260	Admitted.
261	
262	(* When new head = max, descent at position 0 in rank_shift_seq. *)
263	Lemma rs_head_max_descent (L : seq nat) :
264	  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
265	  head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 ->
266	  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 >
267	  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1.
268	Proof.
269	Admitted.
270	
271	(* When new head = min, no descent at position 0 in rank_shift_seq. *)
272	Lemma rs_head_min_no_descent (L : seq nat) :
273	  uniq L -> 1 < size L ->
274	  head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1 ->
275	  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 <
276	  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1.
277	Proof.
278	Admitted.
279	
280	(* Comparison with an out-of-range value is the same for any
281	   element of L or rank_shift_seq L. *)
282	Lemma cmp_out_of_range (L : seq nat) (v : nat)
283	    (j j' : nat) :
284	  j < size L -> j' < size L ->
285	  (v < nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 \/
286	   v > nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
287	  (nth 0 L j > v) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) j' > v).
288	Proof.
289	Admitted.
290	
291	(* Version with v on the left: (v > elem_L) = (v > elem_rs). *)
292	Lemma cmp_out_of_range_left (L : seq nat) (v : nat)
293	    (j j' : nat) :
294	  j < size L -> j' < size L ->
295	  (v < nth 0 (sort leq L) 0 \/
296	   v > nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
297	  (v > nth 0 L j) = (v > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) j').

303	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md sections 2-4.                *)

305	(* ----- Common proof pattern for descent-effect lemmas ---------------------- *)
306	(* Each lemma case-splits k relative to window [i, i+ws):                     *)
307	(*   k+1 < i (prefix), k = i-1 (left boundary), k = i (head),               *)
308	(*   i < k < i+ws (interior), k = i+ws-1 (right boundary), k >= i+ws (suffix)*)

312	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
313	  ~~ is_descent_seq w i ->
314	  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->
315	    is_descent_seq (psi i w) k = (k == i) || is_descent_seq w k.
316	Proof.

321	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->

323	  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->
324	    is_descent_seq (psi i w) k = (k != i) && is_descent_seq w k.

330	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> has_left_child i w ->
331	  ~~ is_descent_seq w i ->
332	  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->
333	    is_descent_seq (psi i w) k =
334	      if k == i then true
335	      else if k == i.-1 then false
336	      else is_descent_seq w k.
337	Proof.
338	Admitted.

342	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> has_left_child i w ->
343	  is_descent_seq w i ->
344	  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->
345	    is_descent_seq (psi i w) k =
346	      if k == i then false
347	      else if k == i.-1 then true
348	      else is_descent_seq w k.
